ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all directors, shareholders, and beneficial owners against the UN Consolidated Sanctions List, US OFAC SDN List, EU CFSP Consolidated List, and the Vanuatu FIU Domestic List of Persons of Concern; risk-based enhanced due diligence for PEPs, PEP family members, and PEP close associates; 5-year adverse media and criminal-history look-back for UBOs; transaction monitoring on SWIFT TT and wire-transfer rails with customer due diligence and suspicious-transaction reporting aligned with FATF Recommendation 16.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: VFSC Companies Office Name Reservation Portal (https://www.vfsc.vu/)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Names must be rendered in Roman/Latin script using English or French characters; an International Company name must end with 'Limited' or the abbreviation 'Ltd'; Bislama and vernacular words are acceptable only when transliterated into standard Roman script without non-ASCII diacritical marks to ensure registry-search compatibility
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Vanuatu (in a manner implying state patronage)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant may file a written appeal to the Registrar of Companies at VFSC within 14 days of the rejection notice, stating grounds of distinctiveness and attaching name-index search evidence; the Registrar issues a final determination within 10 working days; where similarity is the sole ground, the applicant may immediately file an amended name without an additional fee; a reservation extension of up to 30 additional days may be requested by a licensed registered agent before expiry, subject to a renewed reservation fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible — the International Company may use the registered agent's physical office address in Port Vila as its statutory registered office; no own physical premises is required; however, the registered agent must maintain physical custody of statutory records in Vanuatu and a physical service-of-process presence
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: 5% likelihood for low-risk wholesale botanical exporters in the first year; principal inspection focus rests on the registered agent rather than the company; risk adjusts upward to 15–20% if a 25%+ UBO is categorized as a PEP

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act No. 32 of 1992 (Cap 222), Sections 4, 5, 6, 7 and 8; Companies Act Cap 191 (for registration of foreign and domestic trading companies, only if local physical operations are established)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), Companies Registry Section, Port Vila, Vanuatu
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association together with Form IC-1 'Application for Registration of an International Company' and certificate countersigned by the Registered Agent
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum issued, authorised or paid-up capital; no escrow or capital deposit account is required. At least one share of no par value or nominal value must be issued to the subscriber, and the Company may have share capital denominated in any convertible currency.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the subscribers of the International Company hereby adopt the Memorandum and Articles of Association as filed with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission, and subscribe for the initial issued shares of the Company, representing 100 ordinary shares of no par value, for the consideration recorded in the share register. FURTHER RESOLVED, that the registered office of the Company within Vanuatu shall be established and maintained at the office of the registered agent in Port Vila, Vanuatu, and such address is hereby adopted as the Company's statutory registered office. FURTHER RESOLVED, that [Name] and [Name] are appointed as directors and [Name] is appointed as Corporate Secretary, each to hold office until removed by resolution, with full authority to execute and submit all incorporation filings.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission, Corporate Registry online name-search portal
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Conduct a search against the VFSC Companies Registry database to confirm the proposed International Company name does not conflict with existing corporations, protected statutory names, or prohibited terms. Submit a formal name reservation request through a VFSC licensed registered agent including the proposed name, the intended corporate object (international wholesale of dried goji berries and herbal botanicals), and confirmation of name-ending restriction (e.g. 'Limited' or 'Ltd').
required_dossiers: Name search and availability request form
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused as undesirable or deceptively similar, the registered agent shall immediately submit the second-ranked alternative name or file a written submission to the VFSC explaining the distinguishing business element, with no re-filing penalty if submitted within 5 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and execution of fundamental corporate instruments
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent prepares the Memorandum and Articles of Association in accordance with the International Companies Act and the Company's constitutional choices. The instrument must include permitted objects, capital structure, director powers, and any restrictions on local Vanuatu business activity. The subscriber(s) execute the Memorandum and Articles before a notary public or licensed legal practitioner, and the registered agent certifies the same as compliant.
required_dossiers: Identity documents of beneficial owner and subscribers
Certified copy of share subscription agreement
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC queries the constitutive documents for incompleteness or improper form, the registered agent shall prepare supplementary clauses and have the subscriber execute a corrected version, and re-file within 3 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of incorporation application to VFSC
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission, Companies Registry Office, Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File Form IC-1 together with the certified Memorandum and Articles, the registered agent's consent, the registered office consent, and the statutory declaration of compliance with the International Companies Act. The application may be submitted online via the VFSC e-filing platform or physically by the registered agent. Confirm the precise corporate denomination and object, and ensure no local trading activity is declared that would breach non-resident operating restrictions.
required_dossiers: Certified copy of Memorandum and Articles of Association
Director and secretary information and consents
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC issues a deficiency notice or requests additional information, the applicant must provide the missing evidence or revise the declaration within 14 calendar days; VFSC must decide within 30 days. Upon rejection, appeal lies to the Minister of Finance and then to the Supreme Court.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Payment of statutory fees and issuance of certificate of incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC treasury office and Corporate Registry
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval of the application, VFSC issues an invoice for the registration fee. The registered agent pays the state fee by bank transfer in USD or Vanuatu Vatu, after which the VFSC issues the Certificate of Incorporation and registers the Company in the International Companies Register. The certificate must be updated with the date of incorporation and officials' signatures.
required_dossiers: Proof of wire transfer or VFSC payment receipt
Certificate of Incorporation draft for verification
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If payment is misallocated or the certificate contains typographical errors, the registered agent shall submit a written correction request to VFSC with the payment receipt; the corrected certificate is reissued within 2 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Adoption of first board resolutions and filing with registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of directors of the International Company, supervision by VFSC registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The founding directors convene and adopt the pro-forma first board resolution covering share allotment, adoption of the registered office address, and appointment of directors and corporate secretary. Signed minutes and director/secretary consents are placed in the statutory records at the registered office. The registered agent receives a certified copy, updates the company register, and files any notice of director appointment required by VFSC practice.
required_dossiers: Share register reflecting initial share subscription
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a director or secretary refuses consent, the board shall adopt a supplementary resolution to appoint an alternative individual, notify the registered agent, and update the statutory register without affecting the incorporation.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA) and Department of Industry, Ministry of Trade, Tourism, Industry and Commerce; for export operations, Customs and Inland Revenue office under International Company tax-exempt foreign-source trading rules
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Business Licence (International Company Non-Resident Trading) with additional Import/Export Merchant Code for dried botanical products

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Vanuatu Ministry of Climate Change Adaptation, Meteorology, Geo-Hazards, Energy, Environment and National Disaster Management
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B - Environmental Registration (EIA Registration) for low-impact wholesale warehousing, drying, sorting and repacking of dried goji berries and herbal botanicals; no full EIA Study required absent large-scale agro-processing or effluent discharge
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater discharges shall not exceed Vanuatu Trade Effluent Standards (pH 6-9, BOD < 20 mg/L, TSS < 30 mg/L); no VOC emissions from packing operations beyond 100 kg/hour requiring odour control; all dried product waste must be handled as non-hazardous solid waste and disposed through a registered municipal waste collection service; food-handling surfaces must meet WHO Codex hygienic practice and Vanuatu Biosecurity phytosanitary export conditions.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate from the Vanuatu Fire and Emergency Services confirming building structural load compliance, adequate fire extinguishers, emergency exits, smoke detection and evacuation plans; occupational clearance from the Department of Labour requiring workplace risk assessment, personal protective equipment protocols for handling dried herbs, and compliance with Vanuatu Health and Safety at Work Act for warehouse and packing staff; building code approval from Port Vila Municipal Council or relevant provincial authority.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs Authority (VRCA) – official portal: https://vrca.gov.vu; International Company registration authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC).
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign-owned International Company (IC) is registered under the International Companies Act (Cap 222) through a registered agent and obtains a VFSC Company Number. No statutory TIN is issued solely for tax purposes to a pure offshore IC. If the IC conducts domestic taxable supplies or seeks zero-rated export clearance to substantiate VAT-exempt export turnover, it must apply to VRCA for VAT registration using the VFSC certificate, constitutional documents, registered-office address, and board resolution; approval is generally issued within 5 business days.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Vanuatu has no check-the-box, CFC, or hybrid mismatch election regimes. An International Company automatically qualifies as a tax-exempt offshore entity exempt from income tax, capital gains tax, stamp duties on offshore transactions, and VAT on offshore supplies. An IC may, however, elect voluntarily to register for VAT under Section 21 of the Value Added Tax Act 2011 solely to claim zero-rating on export sales and recover input credits; such an election is irrevocable for at least 12 months.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Value Added Tax Act 2011, with export zero-rating for qualifying export supplies; domestic supplies are subject to VAT at the standard rate, while offshore International Company supplies remain outside the domestic VAT nexus.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VAT 4,000,000 (four million vatu) per annum on taxable turnover; voluntary registration is permitted; export-only supplies can be zero-rated even if the supplier does not exceed the local turnover threshold.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Vanuatu does not mandate real-time electronic invoicing, fiscal clearance, API filing, or digital stamping. Taxpayers must issue paper or electronic VAT invoices containing the mandatory particulars set out in the VAT Act and retain supporting documents for at least 5 years for audit purposes.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Zero-rating applies to the supply of goods that are physically exported from Vanuatu to a non-resident destination, and to services rendered offshore or directly to a non-resident for use outside Vanuatu. An International Company exporting dried goji berries and herbal botanicals must demonstrate, through contemporaneous documentation, that the goods left Vanuatu in accordance with the VAT Act and that the customer is a non-resident; the supplier must retain proof of export and payment.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: VRCA and Vanuatu Customs conduct post-clearance audits and may reverse zero-rated treatment where export evidence is deficient or fraudulent. Penalties include understatement penalties of up to 200% of the tax evaded, interest accruals, criminal fines for fraudulent invoices, and revocation of VAT registration; although Vanuatu has no exchange-control legislation, failure to evidence legitimate repatriation is treated by VRCA as a red flag in export substantiation and may trigger an audit and retrospective clawback.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV), established under the Reserve Bank of Vanuatu Act [Cap. 125]; sole monetary authority, currency issuer, and supervisory authority for all licensed banks and authorised foreign-exchange dealers in Vanuatu.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu operates an open, non-exchange-controlled regime. The Vatu (VUV) is officially floating and freely convertible through RBV-licensed authorised dealers for both current-account and capital-account transactions. No RBV approval is required for outward profit remittance, dividend distribution, repatriation of equity, or settlement of bona fide intercompany debts by an International Company. Practical frictions are confined to correspondent-bank de-risking and bank-level documentary checks (board resolution, solvency certificate, underlying export invoices), not statutory conversion quotas. Capital-account convertibility is unrestricted; the only legal obstacle is the completion of client due diligence under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act No. 23 of 2020 (AMLCFT Act).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory surrender obligation and no mandatory conversion ratio apply. An International Company may retain export proceeds indefinitely in foreign currency (USD, AUD, EUR) in onshore or offshore accounts without repatriation deadlines. The AMLCFT Act 2020 imposes record-keeping and transaction-monitoring duties only; there is no RBV-imposed 90-day or 180-day liquidation rule for trade receivables.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Low. Global digital EMIs (Wise, Revolut, Airwallex, Mercury) generally decline Vanuatu-incorporated International Companies due to jurisdiction-risk appetite, residual FATF/EU listing history, and inability to obtain reliable remote UBO verification. Legally, a non-resident EMI may onboard a VU IC only if the EMI holds a valid home-jurisdiction licence and executes full AMLCFT-compatible due diligence; Vanuatu offers no passporting or EMI licensing that grants such providers direct access to VUV clearing rails. A practical alternative is a segregated multi-currency account at a Tier 1 bank with SWIFT access.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Mandatory physical attendance is required: at least one executive director and all ultimate beneficial owners must appear in person at the bank's Port Vila branch (or exceptionally Luganville) for an interview and biometric passport verification. Pure remote opening and video-only e-KYC are not accepted for newly incorporated International Companies. A VFSC-licensed registered agent or local solicitor may introduce the client and attend the meeting, but the physical interview cannot be waived; notarised certified copies of identification and corporate documents remain supplementary, not substitutive.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Tax-exempt International Company with no local economic substance in Vanuatu
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified copy of IC registration certificate; current certificate of good standing from VFSC; registered agent confirmation letter; board resolution appointing directors; UBO declaration with proof of identity; audited or management accounts; underlying trade contracts for dried goji berries/herbal botanicals; warehouse, purchase, and logistics agreements demonstrating substance in the exporting jurisdiction.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Vanuatu jurisdiction risk arising from prior FATF and EU listing status
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Completed bank risk questionnaire; low-risk AML classification rationale; sanctions screening results (UN, OFAC, EU, UK) for all directors and UBOs; source-of-wealth statements; three years of bank reference letters from existing trade counterparties; evidence of no PEP status.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Bearer share or opaque ownership red flag under International Companies Act [Cap. 222]
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Statutory declaration confirming absence of bearer shares; register of members filed with VFSC; articles of association; trust deed and declaration of trust if ownership is held via trust; chain-of-title documentation for any nominee arrangement.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Unclear beneficial ownership through layered nominee or offshore holding vehicles
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Fully completed beneficial ownership schedule; organisational chart evidencing each intermediate entity; certificates of incorporation for each holding layer; tax identification numbers and registered agent letters for all intermediate jurisdictions; sworn UBO certification.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Equity subscription or shareholder loan routed via SWIFT MT103 (or MT202 for interbank) to the VU IC account, cleared through New York correspondent (USD) or Sydney correspondent (AUD); payment must reference ISO 20022 purpose code 'EQUI' for equity injection or 'INTC' for intra-group funding; bank retains board resolution, current IC certificate, certificate of good standing, and UBO declaration as verification. No RBV exchange-control approval is required for inward credit; funds are screened against UN, OFAC, EU, and UK sanctions lists before crediting.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Supplier and logistics settlements executed via direct SWIFT MT103 for open-account trade; documentary trade supported by Commercial Letter of Credit under UCP 600 using MT700/MT707 issued by the Vanuatu bank and confirmed by a first-class international bank for herbal-botanical purchases; domestic VUV-denominated expenses cleared through RBV settlement accounts at the national clearing level; all conversions executed by authorised dealers with simultaneous debit of VUV and credit of USD/AUD without prior regulatory consent.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: VUV/USD outright foreign-exchange forwards with tenors up to 12 months quoted by ANZ or BSP dealing rooms for committed export proceeds
USD/VUV non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) executed with offshore counterparties, reflecting the non-deliverable nature of VUV in global markets
AUD/USD cross-currency swaps with international investment banks to hedge mismatched trade receivable and payable currencies
Natural hedging via multi-currency invoicing: USD-denominated goji berry export contracts with a fixed-fx conversion clause

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual International Company Renewal Remittance (Annual Government Fee)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), International Companies Registry, submitted through the licensed registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before 30 June of each calendar year, in accordance with the VFSC annual renewal cycle
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Non-payment attracts overdue penalties; continued non-payment may lead to a VFSC strike-off notice, administrative dissolution, and vesting of company assets in the Vanuatu Government until restoration is completed.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered Agent Annual Compliance Statement (Registered Office and Statutory Registers Confirmation)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), filed by the licensed registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually with the renewal remittance, no later than 30 June of each calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain a registered agent and registered office is an offence under the International Companies Act; the registered agent must report non-compliance, and VFSC may impose administrative penalties or initiate strike-off proceedings.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual UBO and Register Confirmation to the Registered Agent (Confidential Records, Not a Public Filing)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Licensed registered agent at the Vanuatu registered office; records are held for VFSC inspection and audit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: On or before the 30 June annual renewal date; updated immediately upon any transfer of shares or change of directors
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to update beneficial ownership and statutory register records is a compliance default; directors and the company may be subject to fines under the International Companies Act, and repeated default may trigger VFSC deregistration.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No statutory audit threshold applies to an ordinary Vanuatu International Company. A mandatory independent audit is triggered only when the company holds a VFSC financial-services licence for banking, insurance, securities, or residential company management, or when the board otherwise elects to commission an audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No statutory financial statements are required to be filed for a non-resident International Company. If financial statements are voluntarily prepared or audited, they should be prepared in accordance with International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) as issued by the IASB.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The licensed registered agent must maintain and annually verify the beneficial ownership schedule. Any share transfer must be recorded in the Register of Members, and the beneficial ownership schedule must be updated at the same time. Beneficial ownership data is not filed publicly; VFSC may inspect the records through the registered agent and has statutory audit powers over such registers.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,500 - USD 6,500 per engagement when a voluntary IFRS audit is commissioned; not required for an ordinary International Company
